name: XO Cash
oneLiner: XO is MoonPay's Solana dollar token, issued through M0 infrastructure and backed by segregated U.S. dollars and other high-quality liquid assets.
collateral: Fully reserved 1:1 by U.S. dollars and other high-quality liquid USD-denominated assets held in segregated accounts for stablecoin holders; MoonPay's terms allow depository institutions, qualified custodians, and secure virtual-currency wallets but do not publish XO's current asset allocation
pegMechanism: 1:1 fiat-backed mint and redemption operated by MoonPay using M0 infrastructure on Solana; consumer access is provided through Exodus Pay and MoonPay's payment rails. MoonPay's Stablecoin Terms require onboarding, exclude customers in Canada, New York, Colorado, and the EEA, and promise commercially reasonable redemption efforts without a stated end-to-end settlement maximum. The Solana SPL Token-2022 mint includes pausable, permanent-delegate, and transfer-hook controls held by MoonPay.

jurisdiction.regulator: FinCEN / NYDFS / state money transmitter regulators
jurisdiction.license: MoonPay Money Transmitter Licenses (49 states), New York BitLicense, New York Trust Charter

params.assetLabel: Indexed M held in XO's local Solana custody vault

notices.title: Solana M0 extension bytecode unverified
notices.message: XO Cash runs on an upgradeable Solana M0 extension program whose deployed bytecode remains unverified on OtterSec. Even with funded M vault balances, unverified bytecode prevents proving source equivalence, so Pharos withholds pure-wrapper classification.
